items.quote: by end of the financial year we'll turn the cash positive
items.statement: Cash-positive (operating cash flow) by end of FY27
items.speaker: N. Muthukumar

items.quote: we are pretty confident that we will be able to do the turnaround by end of this year in terms of receivables from the metering business
items.statement: Metering-business receivables turnaround by end of FY27
items.speaker: N. Muthukumar

items.quote: is about INR300 crores for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB, and about INR250 crores for EMS business
items.statement: FY27 capex of about INR 850 crore: OSAT 300, PCB 300, EMS 250
items.speaker: N. Muthukumar

items.quote: we have committed a full year revenue of totally INR500 crores between both
items.statement: OSAT and PCB full-year FY27 revenue of INR 450-500 crore, starting Q3
items.speaker: N. Muthukumar

items.quote: we have committed the 2x of the market growth
items.statement: Revenue growth of 2x the market growth (no absolute number given)
items.speaker: N. Muthukumar

tone.label: confident
tone.why: Management says it is on target for capex, OSAT and PCB revenue and a cash-positive year-end, and says it has improved on last quarter's commitments, though it declines to give an absolute revenue number.
